radius.method: ensurePoint snaps to native cell centre, then sources.near uses sphere/AABB distance <= radius

notes: Regions use original encoded native cell coordinates, not a centroid or stretched metre scale.
Vertical strata are original native y=20 and y=21, each1.06m; no new vertical grid.
Tight bounds are saved fragment unions; conservative bounds use canonical region cell boxes, EPS-expanded and clamped to original owner bounds.
Worst scopes are roof-only demand from one frontier query, not a bound on other carriers, multiple hot sites, support cascades or accumulated residency.
Graph components/ports summarize saved pristine static connectivity only; no damage or support physics is executed.
No per-cell fuel amounts or heat/air cells are present in the saved identity. Region stock/error certificates remain an implementation acceptance requirement.
